charts.name: Stacked bar chart — weekly zone time
charts.series: Stacked HR-zone time per week. Segment colours: Zone0=white (#FFFFFF), Zone1=light blue-grey (#A9B7C2), Zone2=blue (#2E7FB8), Zone3=teal/green (#3BB58F), Zone4=amber (~0, not visible), Zone5=orange (~0, not visible). Plus a white horizontal DASHED reference line = AVG (weekly average ~2:34).
charts.yAxis: Time in h:mm, labels bottom-to-top: 0:00, 1:15, 3:45, 5:00 (note: NOT linearly spaced). Faint horizontal gridlines at each label.
charts.notes: Bars: Jun 3-9 empty; Jun 10-16 empty; Jun 17-23 = tall multi-zone bar (white Zone0 base up to ~2:30, light blue-grey Zone1 up to ~4:00, thin teal/green + blue caps at top), reaching between 3:45 and 5:00; Jun 24-30 = short bar near 0:30 (small white base + thin blue-grey cap). White-tabbed 'AVG.' label at left edge sits on the dashed AVG reference line (~2:34 level). No point currently selected.

charts.name: HR zones proportion bar
charts.series: Single thin full-width horizontal stacked proportion bar of relative time per zone: Zone0 white (#FFFFFF) ~65% left, Zone1 light blue-grey (#A9B7C2) ~30%, Zone2 tiny blue (#2E7FB8), Zone3 tiny teal/green (#3BB58F) at far right. Zones 4/5 = 0, absent. Rounded ends.
charts.notes: Widths reflect legend times: Zone0 1:39 (largest white), Zone1 0:49, Zone2 0:04, Zone3 0:01.

layout.name: Status bar
layout.description: iOS status bar on dark background. Left: time '09:40' in white bold + a small silent/mute bell icon (bell with slash) immediately right of time. Right: cellular signal bars (2 of 4 filled), wifi glyph, battery pill showing '38' with battery outline. All white/light-grey icons.

layout.name: Screen header / nav bar
layout.description: Centered uppercase title 'TREND VIEW' in white, letter-spaced, semibold, ~16px. A left-aligned back chevron '<' (thin white stroke) at far left for navigating back. No right-side action. This header is pinned/persistent across scroll (present in both images).
layout.interaction: Back chevron returns to the previous (metric detail / overview) screen.

layout.name: Metric selector dropdown
layout.description: Full-width rounded pill/card (~#262B30 dark grey, slightly lighter than background, rounded ~16px corners). Left: a heart-with-clock outline icon (white line icon). Center-left text 'HEART RATE ZONES ALL' in bold white uppercase, ~18px, letter-spaced. Far right: a downward chevron 'v' (white). Tapping opens a metric picker to switch which trend metric is shown.
layout.interaction: Opens dropdown/picker to select a different trend metric.

layout.name: Summary stat block (left) — Avg weekly total
layout.description: Left-aligned stacked block. Top label 'AVG. WEEKLY TOTAL' in grey uppercase (~13px, letter-spaced, ~#8A9099). Below it a very large white value '2:34' (bold, ~56px) with a smaller lower-case unit 'hr' (~20px, grey-white) baseline-aligned to the right of the number.

layout.name: Trend-vs-prior-month pill
layout.description: Small rounded pill below the big value, dark amber/brown fill (~#3A2A12). Contains a downward-pointing solid triangle (orange ~#E8912A) followed by orange text '18% vs. prior month' (bold, ~14px). Indicates this period's avg weekly total is 18% lower than the prior month.

layout.name: Time-range segmented toggle
layout.description: Right-aligned segmented control on the same row as the summary stat. Dark rounded container (~#1C2126) with three segments 'W' | 'M' | '6M'. The middle 'M' segment is selected (lighter grey fill ~#3A4047, white text); 'W' and '6M' are unselected (grey text ~#8A9099). Selects Week / Month / 6-Month view.
layout.interaction: Switches the trend time window (W=week, M=month selected, 6M=6 months).

layout.name: Date-range stepper
layout.description: Below the toggle, right-aligned. A left chevron '<' (dim grey), centered range label 'JUN 3 - JUN 30, 26' in white bold uppercase (~16px), and a right chevron '>' (white). The left chevron is dimmer (current/most-recent period). Steps the displayed month range backward/forward.
layout.interaction: Left/right chevrons page the date range to prior/next month.

layout.name: Summary sentence
layout.description: Two-line paragraph in white/light text (~22px, regular weight) spanning full width: 'You spent 0:31 in activities in the last 7 days. This is below your weekly average from the last four weeks (2:34).'
literals: You spent 0:31 in activities in the last 7 days. This is below your weekly average from the last four weeks (2:34).

layout.name: Stacked bar chart — weekly zone time
layout.description: Vertical stacked bar chart of weekly HR-zone time (see charts[0]). Y-axis labels 0:00, 1:15, 3:45, 5:00; x-axis 4 weekly buckets Jun 3-9, Jun 10-16, Jun 17-23, Jun 24-30; white dashed AVG line with white 'AVG.' tab at left (~2:34). Tall multi-zone bar on Jun 17-23, short bar on Jun 24-30, first two weeks empty.
layout.interaction: Likely tap a bar to select that week (no selection currently shown).

layout.name: Chart footnote (info)
layout.description: Small grey info row below the chart: a circled 'i' info icon (grey) followed by grey text 'Zone time is derived from logged activities' (~14px).
literals: Zone time is derived from logged activities

layout.name: HR Zones Breakdown — section header
layout.description: Section title row: 'HR ZONES BREAKDOWN' in bold white uppercase (~16px, letter-spaced) followed inline by '(AVG. WEEKLY TOTAL)' in grey uppercase (~13px). Appears at bottom of image 1 and top of image 2 (same element).

layout.name: HR zones proportion bar
layout.description: A single thin full-width horizontal stacked proportion bar showing relative time split across zones (see charts[1]). Left ~65% solid white (Zone 0), then light blue-grey (Zone 1) ~30%, then tiny blue (Zone 2) and tiny teal/green (Zone 3) at far right; Zones 4/5 absent. Rounded ends.

layout.name: HR zones legend — two-column grid
layout.description: Six zone rows in a 2-column grid (3 rows). Each entry = a small square colour swatch + a bold white time value + a grey 'Zone N' label. Left column top-to-bottom: white swatch '1:39  Zone 0'; blue swatch '0:04  Zone 2'; amber/orange swatch '0:00  Zone 4'. Right column top-to-bottom: blue-grey swatch '0:49  Zone 1'; teal/green swatch '0:01  Zone 3'; orange-red swatch '0:00  Zone 5'. Times bold white, zone labels grey (~#8A9099).

layout.name: Add Activity button
layout.description: Full-width rounded card (~#262B30 dark grey). Left: a '+' plus icon (white). Bold white uppercase label 'ADD ACTIVITY'. Right: a '>' chevron (white). Navigates to add/log an activity.

layout.name: Set HR Zones goal button
layout.description: Full-width rounded card (~#262B30 dark grey). Left: a clipboard-with-check icon (white line icon). Bold white uppercase label 'SET A HR ZONES GOAL IN WEEKLY PLAN'. Right: a '>' chevron (white). Navigates to the Weekly Plan to set an HR-zones goal.
literals: SET A HR ZONES GOAL IN WEEKLY PLAN
layout.interaction: Opens Weekly Plan to set an HR zones goal.

layout.name: Learn More — section header row
layout.description: Row with left bold grey-white uppercase 'LEARN MORE' and right a 'VIEW ALL' link in white bold uppercase followed by a right-arrow '→'. Header for the educational carousel below.
layout.interaction: 'VIEW ALL' navigates to the full list of learn-more content.

layout.name: What is Heart Rate Zone Training? — info card
layout.description: Large rounded dark card (~#15191D). Bold white title 'What is Heart Rate Zone Training?' (~26px). Body paragraph in light-grey regular text: 'Heart rate (HR) zone training is an exercise method that focuses on tracking your heart rate during workouts and maintaining specific HR ranges. Training within these zones helps you manage workout intensity, boosting your cardiovascular health and overall fitness.' Then a second paragraph begins (cut off at bottom of screen): 'On WHOOP, your HR zones are personalized to your unique physiology, based on your heart rate reserve...' (continues below the fold).
literals: What is Heart Rate Zone Training?

Heart rate (HR) zone training is an exercise method that focuses on tracking your heart rate during workouts and maintaining specific HR ranges. Training within these zones helps you manage workout intensity, boosting your cardiovascular health and overall fitness.
On WHOOP, your HR zones are personalized to your unique physiology, based on your heart rate reserve
layout.interaction: none (scrollable text; full article continues below the fold).
